library_preparation_preflight.summary: com.sun.xml.ws:policy:4.0.5 is the WS-Policy library. Its POM already brings in jaxb-runtime, jakarta.xml.ws-api, jakarta.xml.bind-api, jakarta.xml.soap-api and jakarta.annotation-api as compile dependencies. Policy assertions, policy maps and the XML policy model can all be exercised in-process. The library needs no Docker image, network service, or environment or system property.
risks: jakarta.activation-api is only 'provided' in the POM, so it isn't pulled in transitively. Jaxb-runtime normally brings it in through its own dependencies. If it is missing from the test classpath, add it manually.
The library uses ServiceLoader and reflection for policy assertion creators and the policy namespace. If native-image reports missing metadata, verify with the local Gradle and Native Image run.
